hypothesis: Across at least 20 runs per group, calibrated Jev improves shot accuracy over the Jev baseline by at least 10 percentage points without increasing deaths per run.
limitations: Planned: nothing has been measured. Thresholds are a draft pre-registration.
Human-baseline runs may contain behavioural data; only aggregate metrics and artifact hashes are admitted.
Game-engine parity between human and agent inputs must be verified in the producing repository; the host cannot check it.

metrics.description: Smallest number of completed runs in any group.
metrics.name: runs_per_group_min

metrics.description: Calibrated minus baseline Jev accuracy, in percentage points.
metrics.name: calibration_accuracy_gain_pp

metrics.description: Mean deaths per run, Jev baseline.
metrics.name: jev_baseline_deaths_per_run

metrics.description: Mean deaths per run, calibrated Jev.
metrics.name: jev_calibrated_deaths_per_run

metrics.description: Calibrated minus baseline deaths per run.
metrics.name: deaths_per_run_change

procedure: In satellite-vision-scape, run each comparison group under identical controls, physics, perception limits and weapon mechanics.
Record per-run metrics and per-shot/per-decision series; store replays and decision traces locally and report only their SHA-256.
Emit one rain-experiment-submission/v1 JSON per calibration cycle with aggregate measurements and Jev model identity/latency/validation.
Admit it with `python rain_lab.py experiment record V3D-EXP-0004 submission.json`; the host evaluates the criteria.
question: Can an AI agent operating under the same controls, physics, perception constraints and weapon mechanics as a human improve measurable performance through repeated calibrated runs?
rationale: Flagship external experiment. Draft pre-registration: thresholds must be reviewed (and experiment_version bumped if changed) before the first run is recorded. Comparison groups: human baseline, Jev baseline, calibrated Jev, human-assisted Jev.
title: Satellite Vision Scape: does calibration improve Jev under human-equivalent constraints?

controls: same build and map seed across groups
same input rate limits and perception constraints for agent and human
independent: agent group (human, Jev baseline, calibrated Jev, human-assisted Jev)
